heading: Limitation on expenditure of funds for compensation of International Boundary Commissioner to actual hours worked
lead: Funds appropriated on and after September 30, 1996, or otherwise made available under this Act or any other Act may be expended for compensation of the United States Commissioner of the International Boundary Commission, United States and Canada, only for actual hours worked by such Commissioner.

notes.text: Similar ProvisionsSimilar provisions were contained in the following prior appropriation acts: Pub. L. 103–317, title V, § 503, Aug. 26, 1994, 108 Stat. 1764. Pub. L. 103–121, title V, § 503, Oct. 27, 1993, 107 Stat. 1189.
